children.value: > Fact From Story: Gary Wang co-founded FTX.
> > Fact From Story: FTX spiraled into bankruptcy in November.
> > > Fact From Story: Much of Wang's testimony focused on the final days at FTX before the entire operation imploded.
> > > Fact From Story: Wang spoke so fast that U.S. District Judge Lewis Kaplan stopped him at points to ask that he slow his pace.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge: A judge may ask someone to slow down if they are speaking too fast.
> > Fact From Story: Gary Wang was technology chief for FTX.
> > Commonsense Knowledge: The technology chief is in charge of technology for a company.
> Fact From Story: Gary Wang was technology chief for FTX.
> > Fact From Story: Wang owned 10% of Alameda.
> > > Fact From Story: Wang told the court about the advantages that Alameda received by having code baked into FTX's software that allowed special access to the crypto exchange.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge: The technology chief of a company would know about the advantages that another company received by having code baked into the first company's software.
> > Commonsense Knowledge: The technology chief of one company may own a percentage of another company.
> Commonsense Knowledge: The technology chief is the head of technology for a company.
